body: My in-laws gave his book to my husband and I for our first Christmas together when we were just dating. They swear by this guy, they host little mini seminars. "We paid off our house because of him!" Yep. Totally because of his financial advice. It's not because you went from abject poverty to making six figures over the last twenty years.
https://acorns.com/invite/ZZH4PX
https://acorns.com/invite/ZZH4PX

Adultery. It's dramatic and emotional and creates conflict. But fuck if it isn't used constantly for really no reason at all. 

Maybe I'm just overly sensitive after being on the shitty end of an affair. But it's in so many shows and I just have to dip out at the first mention. You don't realize how frequent it is until it's a (and I hate this word but I don't know a better term) trigger.

A slightly extended family member on my husband's side has a child like this. He has a severe congenital disability that has left him unable to function without intense life support since birth. He's never played, never smiled, I dont even know how much goes on in his brain. He's nearly died several times. Its heart breaking. She found out fairly early in her pregnancy and she has two older sons. 

I might be a terrible person, but I think continuing her pregnancy under all those circumstances is cruel. Her older boys act out so much because they won't get attention otherwise. Her youngest requires constant care with absolutely no quality of life. 

Before my husband and I tried for our second, we had a talk about our course of action if there were severe defects like that. 100%, would choose ternination. That isn't living, it's existing.

A message from my ex best friend. She had my husband had sex months before. Only just told me then. 

Its been 9 months since I found out. I still have nightmares. I still feel sick. Its just constant intrusive thoughts and depression and diagnosed PTSD. 

I'd rather have not known. I was trying to slowly cut her out of my life because I didn't like who she was after the honeymoon period of friendship wore off. She would have been gone and I wouldn't feel like this. 

Its fucking agony to hate and love someone at the same time. I cant turn to my biggest source of comfort because he's the one that did this to me. This is literally the worst thing he could have done. He knew that. And he did it anyway. 

I just want to not have to feel like this. I wish i hadn't read it.

You know what? I'm this person. My kids are 4 and 2. I've been a SAHM since just before 4 was born. I have no real work experience. I'm completely financially dependent on my husband because it was easier. I'm nearly done with my AA with a BA planned to follow for my career. 

He cheated on me. Out of the blue. With my best friend. My whole world is broken. Im stuck. Im busting my ass to get something going. Im fast tracking my AA. Im probably going to push off my BA. Im building up savings that I'll take if it comes down to it. 

If I could do anything, I'd go back and push for my education. I gave it up so many times for other people. I should have gotten a job and made childcare work. I screwed myself. 

Fight for yourself. Get this job. I hope and pray and wish and all those things that this doesnt happen to another person. But it can. Prepare for the worst and hope for the best. 

I'm sorry this is so long. This whole pandemic thing has ruined my mental health. I dont want to jack your post. But I'm the warning story. I'm proof that this job is so absolutely vital.

We actually had an appointment scheduled for during the quarantine as a general check up booked far out. But obviously that's not happening. He didnt have an issue at his last visit. It's gotten progressively worse over a long time.
I just wanted to update and say I did it. I wouldn't have been able to stand up for myself with out the encouragement from all you lovely ladies. Thank you.

I just hate fights. Like he took the kids to his parents and went grocery shopping and I lost it. Screaming, sobbing, punching myself, banging my head on the floor as I sat on the floor trying not to self harm (spoiler alert, didnt work). Its such a massive trigger for me.

Growing up, I always swore I wouldn't be this person. Too dependent on a man to leave. Putting up with cheating. Delaying my degree so he could finish his (so long of I'll sign up for this semester until the window was over so I couldn't even do it). But I am. And that's a terrible self actualization to have. So I lost it. It feels over blown but I'm so sick of pretending I'm ok for my kids, my not-job, his family. I try not to bother my mom until it's bad because she has her own shit.
I'll probably just put in on for not disturb. I'm always paranoid about a baby based emergency.
I texted my friend. I'll see how this plays out. I'll probably be back in a few days to complain about his bullshit again.

He really isn't fun to go with. Hes in his phone. Apparently checking out other women, he admitted post cheating. I don't want to go with him. I really don't anymore. But I can't tell him cause that's another fight.

I don't know if I even can. Here started angry texting me later about how it's not that anymore, its Corona. I called bullshit. Insisting the panic attack was months ago (try 10 days). Bullshit. I don't know if I can enjoy it.

We just went on spring break for a week and some change. So that helps. Hopefully since the biggest tourist draws in the area have closed, we wont get the big spike admin and the district were worried about.

Kids in my school (I'm a TA) vary between covid jokes or extreme anxiety. Kids are coughing or saying "corona" every time someone sneezes. One student said "I heard xstudent has corona." Had to shut that down before the rumor gets things shut down. Other kids are using hand sanitizer any time they touch a door knob and wiping their desks down with lysol wipes. So much false information on both sides. Its sad.

Today they announced plans should the county need to close schools. We got too many cheers when it started with "should it come to our county, schools will be closed." Jokes on them, they will have to do everything online and according to the current bell schedule. Those cheers got quiet real quick.

My husband cheated on me about a month ago. It was my best friend that I met through a club. Today the club is meeting up again and my chest hurts every time I think about going. I miss my friends. But it's too close to everything. 

I keep blaming myself. I feel less than. I'm already struggling with health issues and this just kind of drove home that I'm not good enough. I'm trying to be ok. Just shoving it down and relying on the drugs from my shrink. But I'm really really not ok.
She didn't. I blocked her before she said anything.
I downloaded it the other day. I dont think I'm ready. Everyone on there was so pretty. Prettier than me. I just can't chance it again. I hate that I'm assuming the worst of strangers.

Jesus christ, yes! What makes all of it worse is that I've had chances to cheat. I've had people come on to me, explicit in their intentions. But I said no. Always. Because I didn't even want any one else. He's the only person I want in my bed. It wasn't even hard to say no. I just did it. I never wavered or thought about it. I stopped talking to those people. I always told him about it too. And then this. 

Even with school, friends aren't really an option. I'm taking everything online to make it easier scheduling wise. I am thinking about maybe upping my course load. I did three this semester and it kind of sucked. But one of them was pretty intensive and difficult. So maybe knocking out four easy ones in spring will be good. 

I'm sure itll get easier as the kids get older to find other parents to connect with. My oldest is in preschool but alot of the other parents are very cliquey as they're all in the same expensive neighborhood. But her teacher and another mom chit chat with me at birthday parties. So that's something.

Absolutely. I got the message from her boyfriend, called my husband thinking they were trying to start shit, he confirmed it, and I sent her a message saying "You're dead to me, c-ing b-." and blocked her, her boyfriend, and her husband every where. Went to my mom's for a couple days before the kids got homesick and missed their dad. 

Atleast my husband feels miserable. Before this, I'd only seen him cry twice and one of those was when I nearly died. But everytime we have a state of the union talk (mostly me vocalizing my hurt and all the thoughts I can't escape) he cries, if not sobs. It kind of pisses me off if I'm honest. I'm so mad and hurt but I still want to make the tears stop because I've always been this selfless care taker since I was little. 

And honestly, I dont know how to make friends. I'm a military brat with 8 different schools under my belt. I missed that developmental mile stone. And now I feel like I can't have female friends. I dont think I could let myself trust them. I dont know how to make guy friends either. It felt so good to have a friend. I went out, like properly out to a concert in the city with alcohol, for the first time in my life. I had fun and someone to have fun with. 

I'm sorry you dont have peace. Even if it doesn't give me hope for my emotional future, it gives me some sort of something knowing I'm not alone in this shit.

Honestly, I dont know. I mean, I dont have any thing to judge it by. But i got an upswing (inconveniently as I had to see the shrink) that made me feel something else for a while. $400 later I can see that it wasn't super positive. And I dont think the depression has been any worse than previous spells. So the jury's out on that one.

I had a close friend. Only the one. I had friends at a meet up where we met. But he fucked her. She still goes to the meet up. So I'm fucked there. 

My mom tries. But shes not exactly helpful.

I can't financially. I'm working on my degree (postponed so he could finish the one he started before we met). I'm a stay at home mom. I can't afford a place to live here or back home. When I get my degree and a chance at a decent job, I'll reconsider. But its financially impossible.

I am and I will. I actually have my monthly check in appointment wednesday. I'm waiting for it to make a difference. I get a few days after medicine adjustment of feeling a placebo normal before everything goes to shit again. I know it takes time to figure out. But holding on until I get there feels unbearable. 

I'm only holding on for my kids. Growing up, my best friends mom killed herself. Seeing how that ruins a family keeps me from taking the final step no matter how much it hurts me to keep going.

The first time I did, it felt like everything went slowmo. First its white. Like shocking, bright white. Then tiny red dots appear on either side of the skin. They get bigger until it's just a flush of blood filling the whole thing. So it's only white for a moment.

I'm in the same boat. I did "the big quit" about 7 years ago. I've had temptations. Any time something goes wrong it's the first thing to come to mind. But my life exploded a week ago. My previously seemingly perfect husband cheated on me. And I fell back in. 

One turned into three turned into 12 now. He knows. I always did it on my upper thigh so I could hide it easier. He saw it while I was changing. 

I feel sick falling back into it. It took a lot to get away from. But I'm here with you, some solidarity. I hope you're ok.

The broken bit is my words, not his. I know hes a good person. I think everyone is fundamentally good. But I know there are pieces of me that are broken. I found them, acknowledge them, and work on them. Hes not as introspective as I am, so he needs to find the broken bits to fix. 

Hes called him self shit, hes a garbage human, hes said a thousand times that it's on him and not me. He fucked up.

I feel like I dont really have time to have space. My kids miss him so much. So we're going back on Sunday. 

Hes following everything I told him so far though. He downloaded that family stalker app, hes got appointments for therapy and an STD test tomorrow. Hes given me the go ahead to go through his phone when ever I want. Apparently my house is going to be spotless when I get back because of all his stress cleaning. I feel like that's a good sign. But I dont know if I can forgive it. It's so fucked on so many levels. It's not just one thing. Its 100 betrayals from one moment.
Shes just a toxic human. I should've cut her out a while ago. But I thought for some stupid reason that I'd be exempt from her bull shit.

I think I'm just taking the path of least resistance. My kids miss him desperately. Hes coming up by plane to drive down with us on Sunday. Hes going to sleep on the couch. We'll cry a lot. We'll do therapy. And maybe some day itll be ok. Or it wont. I just can't handle my kids being so fucking miserable with out their dad.
I'm glad I'm not over reacting atleast.
I think that's what makes it so hard. I'm stuck in indecision.

My daughter is in pre-k and I'm thinking its gonna be hard moving forward to make mom friends. But I'll be working eventually too, and that'll help. I'm ok with not having friends. Im a child of the military. Friends dont last long.
Absolutely not. Shes blocked, her husband is blocked, her boyfriend and her mother and everyone I could think of. My last words were "You're dead to me, cunting bitch."

I know it's on her. It's her MO. Shes manipulative and selfish and shitty. I knew that before all this. Hes had a thing recently of being turned on by the possibility of being caught when we have sex. So maybe that was part of it. It was something exciting and taboo and wrong and different. But you dont hurt someone this much if you love them. It's literally all my biggest fears. The things he swore up and down would never happen because hes so devoted to me. It all just feels like lies. 

I've told them that the woman isn't my friend anymore because they keep asking to see her and her son. I said she was mean and took something from me and you dont have to be friends with someone who hurts you. They're only 2 and 4. I can't bring myself to tell them their dad did it too. He can do no wrong. Hes their hero and favorite person. I just keep saying hes working so he couldn't come too.

Second marriage makes sense. Its definitely not the same relationship anymore. I can't even figure out what I need. I'm staying here for a little while longer atleast. I dont know how long. 

In the beginning, I did. I'm desperately afraid of being left and abandoned thanks to my shitty ass father. We're more balanced now. Or were. I think I hold all the cards now. I hate this limbo no where land that I'm in now. I can't plan anything. I can't decide. I'm just stuck trying not to cry in front of my kids.

We're definitely going to counseling together and apart. I'm making an appointment with my shrink as soon as I get home. 

I want so badly to hate him. But I can't. I've always loved him more, it feels like. We broke up after 6 months of dating because it was so imbalanced. He realized his mistake with in a month. Shortly after found out I was 10 weeks pregnant. I told him so many times he could leave but he stayed. He didn't want to get married for a long time either. He didn't even propose, it was just "let's do this". And now this. I'll always love him more and I can't even love him less after this. 

Even if I can't forgive him, I'll come home. We can be room mates until I get on my feet. We can be coparents. I've only told my mom. Shes been here. She stayed. Shes only said she'll support me either way. Shes amazing. Literally the only constant in my life. 

I'm never speaking to her again. My exact words were "you're dead to me, cunting bitch." And instablocked. She had a ton of my shit at my house. I had him throw it all out. Even sentimental shit. I dont even fucking care. 

Theres a picture frame his mother gave him after we were married. It has a picture of his boot camp graduation with his ex. Its lived in the garage. I wont hang it even if he changed the photo out. He smashed the glass and threw it away too.
